<text x="112.5" y="104.0" font-size="19" font-weight="600" fill="#dc2626" text-anchor="start" dominant-baseline="auto" textLength="336.6" lengthAdjust="spacing">is one to many: TTS draws a sample</text>
</g>
<g class="fragment" data-fragment-index="2">
<rect x="20.0" y="126.0" width="960.0" height="52.0" rx="6" fill="#ede9fe" stroke="#7c3aed" stroke-width="1.2"/>
<text x="36.0" y="141.0" font-size="19" font-weight="700" fill="#7c3aed" text-anchor="start" dominant-baseline="middle">1  who decides the length?</text>
<text x="36.0" y="164.0" font-size="19" font-weight="400" fill="#1f2328" text-anchor="start" dominant-baseline="middle">attention · a duration predictor · the AR stop symbol · given from outside</text>
<text x="964.0" y="141.0" font-size="19" font-weight="600" fill="#6b7280" text-anchor="end" dominant-baseline="middle">§2</text>
<rect x="20.0" y="183.0" width="960.0" height="52.0" rx="6" fill="#fee2e2" stroke="#dc2626" stroke-width="1.2"/>
<text x="36.0" y="198.0" font-size="19" font-weight="700" fill="#dc2626" text-anchor="start" dominant-baseline="middle">2  who generates the variation?</text>
<text x="36.0" y="221.0" font-size="19" font-weight="400" fill="#1f2328" text-anchor="start" dominant-baseline="middle">autoregression over W6's tokens, or a velocity field on continuous mel / latents</text>
<text x="964.0" y="198.0" font-size="19" font-weight="600" fill="#6b7280" text-anchor="end" dominant-baseline="middle">§3, §4</text>
<rect x="20.0" y="240.0" width="960.0" height="52.0" rx="6" fill="#dbeafe" stroke="#0b5cad" stroke-width="1.2"/>
<text x="36.0" y="255.0" font-size="19" font-weight="700" fill="#0b5cad" text-anchor="start" dominant-baseline="middle">3  who renders the waveform?</text>
<text x="36.0" y="278.0" font-size="19" font-weight="400" fill="#1f2328" text-anchor="start" dominant-baseline="middle">a vocoder (W2's phase, W6's discriminators), a codec decoder, or an iSTFT</text>
<text x="964.0" y="255.0" font-size="19" font-weight="600" fill="#6b7280" text-anchor="end" dominant-baseline="middle">§5</text>
<rect x="20.0" y="297.0" width="960.0" height="52.0" rx="6" fill="#fff7ed" stroke="#b45309" stroke-width="1.2"/>
<text x="36.0" y="312.0" font-size="19" font-weight="700" fill="#b45309" text-anchor="start" dominant-baseline="middle">4  how long does each decision delay the first packet?</text>
<text x="36.0" y="335.0" font-size="19" font-weight="400" fill="#1f2328" text-anchor="start" dominant-baseline="middle">three shapes of the first packet; W1's TTS cell gets its number</text>
<text x="964.0" y="312.0" font-size="19" font-weight="600" fill="#6b7280" text-anchor="end" dominant-baseline="middle">§6</text>
</g>
</svg>
